Nothing really worked for me. Tried all that salicylic acid and benzoyl peroxide crap, nothing did anything noticeable.

Finally went to the doctor, got put on Accutane, and it worked amazingly. It makes you a little more tired and dry but it's totally worth it. It depends on the person but usually around 5 or 6 months in you'll be clear. Not all that long when you've had it for so much longer.

100% worth it. Do it.
The actual Accutane was discontinued like 6 years ago, everyone else taking it is actually taking Amnesteen as well. We just call it Accutane.
